name: tier2tickets-relay
description: Cloudflare Worker that impersonates a HaloPSA instance so Tier2Tickets / Helpdesk Buttons can create tickets in Gorelo.

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply tier2tickets-relay --local -c wrangler.dev.toml
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply tier2tickets-relay-staging --env staging --remote
scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.dev:setup: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
